W05

Role-aware Home

/app/home
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S01, S14, S17

Provide one academic starting point with student, instructor and TA variants. The selected course role determines the visible tasks and terminology.

Entry and return
W02 successful returnGlobal Home navigationW04 completionBack from shared tools
Layout regions
Global shellHome, Courses, Calendar, Activity, Tools; Search, Help, Account; Explicit institution and active academic context
Primary tasksStudent: personal due work and received status; Instructor: course setup, reviews and pending release; TA: allocated marking, grading deadlines and access expiry
Secondary railUpcoming academic events, published announcements and released-feedback availability; No grade or score in preview cards

Stay hereSwitch context
Permissions
  • Staff counts never enter learner cards.
  • TA tasks show allocated learners/work only; policy and release actions absent.
  • Private calendar titles appear only for the signed-in owner.
Responsive
  • Primary tasks precede secondary rail when stacked.
  • Role selector remains visible inside collapsed navigation; no native tab bar.
Accessibility
  • Cards have descriptive links including course and work title.
  • New and stale states use text; preserve focus after partial panel refresh.
Data
  • Role-filtered task summaries, personal dates, receipt state and source timestamps.
  • Calendar and activity references share their underlying record IDs.
Acceptance checks (3)
  • A student sees feedback availability without a score in Home.
  • A TA with no allocation sees a truthful empty queue and no instructor task buttons.
  • A failed calendar panel leaves course and coursework links working.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
